changed.title: The accuracy budget for graph pigeonhole clause search under correlated sources with bounded neighboring mass ratios
changed.statement:
∃ C n₀ : ℕ, 2 ≤ C ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, n₀ ≤ n →
  ∃ G : PEqualNP.Expanders.BipGraph (n+1) n,
    PEqualNP.Expanders.LeftDegLe G C ∧ PEqualNP.Expanders.RightDegLe G C ∧
    let V := PEqualNP.Expanders.GEdge G
    let X := V → Bool
    let e := Fintype.card V
    let F := PEqualNP.Expanders.funGraphPHP G
    ∀ (b T h R : ℕ) (S : Finset (Fin b → ZMod 2)) (cap : (Fin b → ZMod 2) → ℕ),
      1 ≤ R → S.Nonempty → (∀ y ∈ S, 1 ≤ cap y) →
      let Y := Fin b → ZMod 2
      let flat := sSup {k : ℕ | ∃ (U : Submodule (ZMod 2) Y) (y : Y),
        Module.finrank (ZMod 2) U = k ∧ ∀ u ∈ U, y + u ∈ S}
      let B := min (∑ y ∈ S, cap y) (T + S.sup cap + flat)
      let L := Nat.clog 2 (R+1)
      let smooth := fun μ : X → ℝ => (∀ x, 0 ≤ μ x) ∧ 0 < ∑ x, μ x ∧
        ∀ x v, μ x ≤ (R : ℝ) * μ (Function.update x v (!(x v)))
      let possible := fun (allSources : Bool) => ∃ (H : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit)
          (pick : Fin b → Fin (2+e+H.size)) (out : Y → Finset (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause V)),
        PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (2+e) H ∧
        (∀ g ∈ H.gates, ((g.op = .and ∨ g.op = .or) ∧ g.inputs.length = 2) ∨
          g.op = .mod 2 ∨ (g.op = .not ∧ g.inputs.length = 1)) ∧
        H.gates.countP (fun g => @decide (g.op = .and ∨ g.op = .or) (Classical.propDecidable _)) ≤ T ∧
        (∀ y ∈ S, (out y).card ≤ cap y ∧ ∀ cl ∈ out y, cl ∈ F) ∧
        let msg := fun (x : X) (j : Fin b) =>
          let ws := H.wires ([false,true] ++ List.ofFn (fun i : Fin e => x ((Fintype.equivFin V).symm i)))
          ((ws.getD (pick j).val false).toNat : ZMod 2)
        (∀ x : X, msg x ∈ S) ∧
        let bad := Finset.univ.filter (fun x : X =>
          @decide (∀ cl ∈ out (msg x), PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.ClauseSat x cl) (Classical.propDecidable _))
        let accurate := fun μ : X → ℝ => (2 : ℝ)^h * (∑ x ∈ bad, μ x) ≤ ∑ x, μ x
        if allSources then (∀ μ, smooth μ → accurate μ) else (∃ μ, smooth μ ∧ accurate μ)
      (possible false → min (n*L) h ≤ C*L*B) ∧
      (C * min n ((R+1)^C*h) ≤ B → possible true)

changed.title: A planar three-matching family has full zero-pin query rank on every split of its boundary terminals at one common price vector
changed.statement:
∀ k : ℕ, 0 < k →
  let n := 8*k^2
  let I := Fin n
  let V := Bool × I
  let T := Fin (2*k)
  let E := Fin 3 × I
  ∃ (σ τ : Equiv.Perm I) (pin : T → V) (z : E → ℕ),
    let dest := fun e : E => if e.1 = 0 then e.2 else if e.1 = 1 then σ e.2 else τ e.2
    let arc := fun (a b : V) => !a.1 && b.1 &&
      (decide (a.2 = b.2) || decide (σ a.2 = b.2) || decide (τ a.2 = b.2))
    let link := fun a b => arc a b || arc b a
    let G := Option V
    let rim := fun a : V => decide (∃ j, pin j = a)
    let inc := fun (x y : G) => x.elim (y.elim false rim) (fun a => y.elim (rim a) (link a))
    Function.Injective pin ∧ (∀ i j : V, Relation.ReflTransGen (fun a b => link a b = true) i j) ∧
    (∃ (l : ℕ) (src dst : Fin l → G) (rot rev : Equiv.Perm (Fin l)),
      Function.Injective (fun d => (src d,dst d)) ∧
      (∀ a b : G, inc a b = true ↔ ∃ d, src d = a ∧ dst d = b) ∧
      (∀ d, src (rev d) = dst d ∧ dst (rev d) = src d ∧ src (rot d) = src d) ∧
      (∀ a b, src a = src b → ∃ j : ℕ, (rot^j) a = b) ∧
      let walk := fun a : Fin l => rot (rev a)
      let faces := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin l)).image (fun a =>
        (Finset.range l).image (fun j => walk^[j] a))
      2*(2*n+1) + 2*faces.card = 4+l) ∧
    (∀ e, 2 ≤ z e ∧ z e ≤ (3*n+1)*8^(2*k+1)) ∧
    ∀ A : Finset T,
      let mat : Matrix (Finset T) (Finset T) ℚ := fun P Q =>
        ∑ x : V → Bool, if (∀ j ∈ A ∩ P, x (pin j) = false) ∧
            (∀ j ∈ Q, j ∉ A → x (pin j) = false) then
          ∏ e : E, (if x (false,e.2) = x (true,dest e) then 1 else (z e : ℚ)) else 0
      Matrix.rank mat = 2^(min A.card (2*k-A.card))

changed.title: Signed boundary-pin histograms identify a hidden pair with lies within an additive constant of the ternary sphere bound
changed.statement:
∀ errors : ℕ, ∃ C : ℕ, ∀ t : ℕ, 2 ≤ t →
  let T := Fin t
  let V := Option (T × Bool)
  let Pair := {p : T × T // p.1 < p.2}
  let E := Fin 3 × T
  let Mask := T → Fin 3
  let tail := fun e : E => if e.1 = 0 then some (e.2,false) else (none : V)
  let head := fun e : E => some (e.2,decide (e.1 ≠ 1))
  let weight := fun (g : Option Pair) (e : E) (diff : Bool) =>
    if e.1 = 0 then diff.toNat else if e.1 = 2 then 1 else
    if g.elim false (fun p => decide (p.val.1 = e.2 ∨ p.val.2 = e.2)) then
      (if diff then 1 else 3) else (2 : ℕ)
  let obs := fun (g : Option Pair) (p : Mask) =>
    ∑ x : V → Bool, if (∀ i : T, p i = 0 ∨ p i = (if x (some (i,false)) then 2 else 1)) ∧
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun e : E => x (tail e) ≠ x (head e))).card = 2*t then
      ∏ e : E, weight g e (xor (x (tail e)) (x (head e))) else 0
  let raw := fun (g : Option Pair) (p : Mask) =>
    g.elim (0 : Fin 3) (fun e => if p e.val.1 = 0 ∨ p e.val.2 = 0 then 0
      else if p e.val.1 = p e.val.2 then 1 else 2)
  let answer := fun (g : Option Pair) (p : Mask) =>
    if obs g p = obs none p then (0 : Fin 3) else if obs none p < obs g p then 1 else 2
  (∀ (g : Option Pair) (p : Mask), answer g p = raw g p ∧
    4*obs g p = (if raw g p = 0 then 4 else if raw g p = 1 then 5 else 3)*obs none p) ∧
  ∀ (pool : Finset (Option Pair)) (budget : Option Pair → ℕ),
    (∀ g ∈ pool, budget g ≤ errors) →
    let feasible := fun d : ℕ =>
      ∃ (ask : (i : Fin d) → (Fin i.val → Fin 3) → Mask)
        (out : (Fin d → Fin 3) → Option Pair),
        ∀ g ∈ pool, ∀ transcript : Fin d → Fin 3,
          (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin d => transcript i ≠ answer g
            (ask i (fun j => transcript (j.castLE (Nat.le_of_lt i.isLt)))))).card ≤ budget g →
          out transcript = g
    let volume := fun (d : ℕ) => ∑ g ∈ pool,
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (budget g+1), 2^j * d.choose j
    ∀ d : ℕ, (feasible d → volume d ≤ 3^d) ∧ (volume d ≤ 3^d → feasible (d+C))

changed.title: One count of optimal fan-in-two AND/OR equality functions fitting negative two-name tests gives a zero-one permanent by a Fibonacci remainder
changed.statement:
let header := fun n : Nat => List.replicate n true ++ [false]
let field := fun (k z : Nat) => (List.range (k.log2+1)).map (fun h => z.testBit h)
let fast := fun f : List Bool → List Bool =>
  ∃ M : Turing.TM2ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) f,
    ∀ i, Finite (M.tm.Γ i)
∃ write read : List Bool → List Bool, fast write ∧ fast read ∧
  ∀ (n : Nat), 0 < n → ∀ A : Fin n → Fin n → Bool,
    let v := 2*n
    let L := 2*(1+v*((v+1).log2+1))
    let k := v*(L+1)
    let b := Nat.fib (L+2)
    let B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Nat := fun i j => (A i j).toNat
    let cells := (List.finRange n).flatMap (fun i => (List.finRange n).map (fun j => (i,j)))
    let base := (cells.filter (fun z => A z.1 z.2)).map (fun z =>
      (z.1.val*(L+1),(n+z.2.val)*(L+1)))
    let good := fun (x y : Nat) => (x,y) ∈ base ∨ (y = x+1 ∧ x/(L+1) = y/(L+1))
    let ban := (List.range k).flatMap (fun x => ((List.range k).filter (fun y =>
      decide (x < y ∧ ¬ good x y))).map (fun y => (x,y)))
    let Fn := (Fin k → Bool) → (Fin k → Bool) → Bool
    let fits := fun f : Fn => (∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit,
      PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 C ∧ C.size+1 ≤ 2*k ∧
      PEqualNP.Represents.Represents (fun i j : Fin k => decide (i=j)) C ∧
      ∀ x y, f x y = C.eval (List.ofFn x ++ List.ofFn y)) ∧
      ∀ e ∈ ban, f (fun i => decide (i.val = e.1 ∨ i.val = e.2)) (fun _ => false) = false
    let Z := Nat.card {f : Fn // fits f}
    write (header n ++ cells.map (fun z => A z.1 z.2)) =
      header k ++ ban.flatMap (fun e => field k e.1 ++ field k e.2) ∧
    fits (fun x y => decide (∃ i, x i = true ∧ y i = true)) ∧
    v.factorial < b ∧ Z % b = B.permanent ∧
    read (header n ++ Z.bits) = B.permanent.bits
changed.unlocks: Reduces the zero-one permanent to one count of distinct full functions on feasible two-name observations, with the answer given by one ordinary remainder.
changed.context: Use blocks of L+1 names with each old vertex first. Require the two-name probe on every nonedge to be false. The optimal equality classification counts one full function per matching, including the identity. Each old perfect matching contributes F(L+1)^(2n), congruent to one modulo F(L+2) by Cassini. Smaller matchings contribute multiples of that modulus. Doubling every two Fibonacci steps gives F(L+2)>v!. Enumerate the forbidden pairs, compute the modulus by addition and take a binary remainder, all in polynomial time.
